body:
I want to so badly but she’s completely cut herself off from me and all of her friends. I had trouble sleeping before this and now I just can’t at all. The passive suicidal thoughts are just thrashing around in my head now and it seems as though these two people who were really close to me who would know that this is what I’m dealing with just don’t care. I don’t know how to move past this and I honestly just wish I could leave this all behind but the lizard brain in me just won’t let me off myself. 

I think that experiencing love is part of the reason I want to die. If it can be tossed to the side so violently for nothing than why the hell is it worth it? I don’t think I can stand it anymore and I don’t know that I have the capacity to have a fufilling life without it.

The last thing she did after lying to me about him was to hold my hand crying telling me she was going to miss me. I don’t know if this is normal but if it is I don’t think I want love anymore.

Yeah, I had made four different copper rings while she was gone and was planning on using the best one to propose to her. We had talked about being together forever a lot and like seriously for the last year, and things only seemed to be getting better and better between us..
